input.question:
Which three recipient addresses received the largest summed value in Transfer logs emitted by 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7 (the token contract) on chain 1 in the last 24 hours?
window: The observation covers the last 24 hours ending at the latest finalized block available when requested. Resolve this once to inclusive fromBlock and toBlock; state reads use toBlock.
missing: If any required data is unavailable, inconsistent or incomplete, report inability; do not encode unknown as zero, false or an empty list.
event: event Transfer(address indexed from,address indexed to,uint256 value)
metric: log-rank over Transfer logs emitted by 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7 only: key indexed to, sum value in raw token units. Exclude recipient 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000. Include every indexed from (sender). Keep only positive totals.
ordering: Descending summed value; ties by ascending numeric 20-byte address. Return up to 3 unique entries; fewer when fewer eligible recipients; empty only for a complete zero-activity set.
